verdict.rationale: The ChatGPT app documents photo upload for interpreting image content: "Snap or upload a picture to transcribe a handwritten recipe or get info about a landmark." That covers the core of sharing a photo and having the assistant understand it. The only support is a brief app-store marketing line, so the depth and accuracy of interpretation are unverified. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of uploading user screenshots, in-depth docs on image understanding (e.g., charts, UI or document screenshots), and independent or hands-on evidence of interpretation accuracy.
